verdicts.reason: Both are nearly identical crammed leaderboard strips. In both, the RSVP button has shrunk to the same size as the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS pills, so the CTA no longer stands out. The legal text, details and URL on the right are tiny and low-contrast and collide with a bokeh dot. A broken 'missing asset' placeholder sits next to 'Saturday 21 June', and the subhead is a cramped two-line block under the headline. In A the can is jammed against the placeholder; B gives it a little more room from the logo cluster, which makes B marginally less cramped.
